appraisal_events.evidence: surtout depuis qu'Odette avait présenté Forcheville aux Verdurin
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette introduces Forcheville into the Verdurin circle, granting him entry into the valued social space Swann himself frequents; the text ties this directly to Swann's rising distress.

status_effects.explanation: Forcheville gains admission to the Verdurin salon through Odette's introduction, a quiet but concrete rise in his social standing within the circle.

ambiguities: Odette's comparison to Swann's mother and friends (in the 'femme entretenue' passage) was considered but treated as part of the already-captured movement of Swann's self-deception about dependency, rather than a distinct status shift for Odette herself, so it was not scored.

M. Verdurin appears only as part of the collective 'chez les Verdurin' venue reference, and princesse de Parme appears only as an illustrative comparison point for Swann's leveled social attitude; neither has a distinct local outcome of their own, so both were omitted.
